_comment: Manual corrections for scripts/golf_providers/build_registry.py. `block` refuses a provider slug for one master course (course_id) or for every course (course_id omitted). `force` pins a provider slug to a master course regardless of the matcher.

block.reason: AIT Golf Club (Asian Institute of Technology, Khlong Luang) is not Alpine Golf Club — the old fuzzy matcher paired them.
Rooks Khorat Country Club (Pak Thong Chai) is a different club from Korat Country Club.
